CREATE DATABASE ldw;
ALTER DATABASE ldw COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8;

USE ldw;

CREATE SCHEMA silver

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE silver
WITH ( location = 'https://adlsfhirnonprod.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/30tb/'),
CREDENTIAL = sqlondemand );

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS silver.claimDiagnosisView;

CREATE VIEW silver.claimDiagnosisView 
AS SELECT *
FROM  
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'Claim_diagnosis',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'silver',
        FORMAT='DELTA'
    ) 
WITH ( 
    claim_id nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    diagnosis_reference nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    diagnosis_sequence int,
    year int,
    month nvarchar(2) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    day nvarchar(2) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2
    )
    claimDiagnosis



DROP VIEW IF EXISTS silver.claimInsuranceView;

CREATE VIEW silver.claimInsuranceView 
AS SELECT *
FROM  
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'Claim_insurance',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'silver',
        FORMAT='DELTA'
    ) 
WITH ( 
    claim_id nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    [insurance_coverage.display] nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    insurance_focal bit,
    insurance_sequence int,
    year int,
    month nvarchar(2) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    day nvarchar(2) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2
    )
    claimInsurance;

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS silver.claimMainView;

CREATE VIEW silver.claimMainView 
AS SELECT *
FROM  
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'Claim_main',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'silver',
        FORMAT='DELTA'
    ) 
WITH ( 
    claim_id nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    resourceType nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    status nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    billablePeriod_end nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    billablePeriod_start nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    created nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    patient_display nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    patient_id_reference nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    prescription_reference nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    provider_display nvarchar(100) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    provider_org_id_reference nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    total_currency nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    total_value float,
    isuse nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    year int,
    month nvarchar(2) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    day nvarchar(2) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2
    )
    claimMain;


CREATE VIEW silver.claimProcedureView 
AS SELECT *
FROM  
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'Claim_procedure',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'silver',
        FORMAT='DELTA'
    ) 
WITH ( 
    claim_id nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    procedure_reference nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,

    year int,
    month nvarchar(2) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    day nvarchar(2) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2

CREATE VIEW silver.observationComponentView 
AS SELECT *

    component_valueQuantity_unit nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2,
    component_valueQuantity_value float,

    day nvarchar(2) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2
